answer_1.quote: Simile generation (SG) is a crucial task in natural language processing, with the aim of polishing literal sentences into similes.
answer_1.outputs: Generated simile sentences (literal sentence polished with a vehicle phrase)

answer_2.quote: We compare our quality metric with the following automatic metrics: (1) BLEU ... (2) RougeL ... (3) METEOR ... (4) BERTScore ... (5) Perplexity ... and our HAUSER metrics (quality, relevance, consistency_l, consistency_s, creativity, informativeness).

answer_4.quote: Then, for each perspective, three raters are asked to rate each simile from 1 to 5, where 1 denotes the worst and 5 denotes the best.
answer_4.guideline: Raters rate each generated simile on a 1‑5 Likert scale for each evaluation perspective (quality, relevance, logical consistency, sentiment consistency, creativity, informativeness).
